DepositToAccountRef.description: Reference to the account where funds are deposited

actions.description: Create an estimate for a customer in QuickBooks Online.
actions.name: create-estimate

value.description: The ID of the customer for this estimate. Example: "123"

TxnDate.description: The date of the transaction in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: "2024-01-15"

Amount.description: The monetary amount of this line item. Example: 100.00

value.description: The ID of the item. Example: "1"

Line.description: The line items for this estimate

Address.description: Email address to send the estimate

Id.description: The unique identifier of the created estimate

SyncToken.description: The sync token for concurrency control

DocNumber.description: The document number of the estimate

actions.description: Create a customer invoice with line items
actions.name: create-invoice

txnDate.description: Transaction date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to the current date if omitted. Example: "2024-01-15"

dueDate.description: Due date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to the transaction date plus the sales terms if omitted. Example: "2024-02-14"

docNumber.description: Invoice number. If omitted, QuickBooks assigns the next number when automatic numbering is on. Example: "INV-1001"

currencyRef.description: Currency of the invoice. Only needed when multicurrency is enabled; defaults to the home currency. Example: { "value": "USD" }

projectRef.description: Project to assign the invoice to. Only for companies with Projects enabled. The value must be a project ID, not a customer ID; omit it when the invoice is not part of a project.

actions.description: Create a product or service item
actions.name: create-item

name.description: Name of the item. Must be unique. Example: "Office Supplies"

incomeAccountId.description: ID of the income account. Required for Inventory, Service, Product, Other Charge types

expenseAccountId.description: ID of the expense account. Required when purchase information is provided

assetAccountId.description: ID of the asset account. Required for Inventory type

trackQtyOnHand.description: Whether to track quantity on hand. Required for Inventory type

qtyOnHand.description: Initial quantity on hand. Required for Inventory type

actions.description: Create a QuickBooks journal entry
actions.name: create-journal-entry

Amount.description: Line amount. Must balance with other lines

Line.description: Journal entry lines. Must include at least two lines that balance: one Debit and one Credit

TxnDate.description: Transaction date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: "2024-01-15"

PrivateNote.description: Private note for the journal entry

DocNumber.description: Document number for the journal entry

line_count.description: Number of lines in the journal entry

actions.description: Record a customer payment against invoices

CustomerRef.description: Reference to the customer making the payment

TotalAmt.description: Total amount of the payment. Example: 100.00

LinkedTxn.description: Linked transactions (e.g., invoices to apply payment to)

TxnId.description: The ID of the transaction to link to. Example: "123"

DepositToAccountRef.description: Account to deposit the payment to

actions.description: Update an account using its current SyncToken

syncToken.description: Current SyncToken for optimistic locking. Example: "0"

description.description: Account description. Example: "Description of the account"

actions.description: Update a bill using its current SyncToken

actions.description: Update a QuickBooks credit memo

id.description: The unique identifier of the credit memo. Example: "123"

customerRef.description: Customer reference. Required when creating; optional for updates only when not changing the customer.

line.description: Line items for the credit memo

id.description: Line item ID for existing lines

totalAmt.description: Total amount of the credit memo

applyTaxAfterDiscount.description: Whether to apply tax after discount

customerMemo.description: Memo to be displayed to the customer

actions.description: Update a customer using its current SyncToken.
actions.name: update-customer

Id.description: The unique identifier of the customer. Example: "1"

SyncToken.description: The version identifier for the customer. Required for concurrency control.

realmId.description: Optional realmId override. Uses connection config realmId if not provided.

sparse.description: Set to true for sparse update to send only changed fields.

DisplayName.description: The display name of the customer.

GivenName.description: The first name of the customer.

FamilyName.description: The last name of the customer.

MiddleName.description: The middle name of the customer.

Suffix.description: The suffix of the customer (e.g., Jr., Sr., III).

Title.description: The title of the customer (e.g., Mr., Mrs., Dr.).

CompanyName.description: The company name associated with this customer. Use null to clear.

PrimaryEmailAddr.description: The primary email address of the customer.

PrimaryPhone.description: The primary phone number of the customer.

Mobile.description: The mobile phone number of the customer.

Fax.description: The fax number of the customer.

BillAddr.description: The billing address of the customer.

ShipAddr.description: The shipping address of the customer.

CurrencyRef.description: The currency reference for this customer.

sparse.description: Set to true for sparse updates (partial updates). When true, only provided fields are updated.

id.description: The unique identifier of the updated deposit.

syncToken.description: The new SyncToken after the update.

totalAmount.description: The total amount of the deposit.

privateNote.description: The private note for the deposit.

lineCount.description: The number of line items in the deposit.

actions.description: Update an existing estimate in QuickBooks with sparse update support.

sparse.description: When true, only provided fields are updated (sparse update).

actions.description: Update an invoice using its current SyncToken
actions.name: update-invoice

Id.description: The unique identifier of the invoice to update. Example: "123"

SyncToken.description: The current sync token of the invoice for optimistic locking. Example: "1"
